name: primality_check_extensions
description: Primality test using documented extensions '||' and '/' (Practicum Example 1.3 & 2.3)
source:
begin
    I := 2;
    R := 1;
    while (M > I * I) || (M = I * I) do
        if (M / I) * I = M then
            begin
                R := 0;
                I := M
            end
        else
            I := I + 1
end
